module: Flowgraph 'graph' class: a graph of nodes and links belonging to a manager (self.mgr). A graph has a type ('graph', 'macro' or 'instance'), nodes, links, pins, a local variableStorage and an optional parent (parentId). It can create and delete nodes and links, check pin compatibility, serialize and deserialize its data and, for a root graph, plan the node execution order (plan). The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/graph')(mgr, name, forceId).
notes: Graphs are stored flat in mgr.graphs; the hierarchy comes from parentId (getChildren iterates over mgr.graphs and sorts by id).

plan() does nothing for a macro or for a graph that has a parent: only the root plans, aggregating the nodes and links of its children (gatherNodesAndLinks) and resolving the macro/integrated and macro/io nodes (virtual links).

plan() determines the root nodes (triggerable, or with no local input pin and a flow output), propagates the "flow colors" and generates the ordered execution code (_workDynamicRepeat / _workDynamicOnce calls).
createNode also creates a hidden link from the enterState pin of the events/onUpdate node to the reset pin of 'once' nodes if the preference flowgraph.general.autoConnectResetPins is active.
deleteLink and deleteNode do not immediately remove the object from the editor: they record the id in mgr.linksToRemove / mgr.nodesToRemove, processed by the manager.
Probable bug: getDeepChild uses current.children, a field commented out in init (self.children does not exist), so getMacro with non-empty indices fails.
pinsCompatible can return nil (instead of false) when no type matches.

onUpdateNodeId.desc: id of the graph's events/onUpdate node

C.desc: Graph object returned by the constructor.

init.desc: Initializes the graph: id, name, type 'graph', empty tables, variableStorage, view position and zoom.

getChildren.desc: Returns the child graphs (parentId == id), sorted by id.

clearVariableChangesChildren.desc: Clears the pending variable changes of this graph and its descendants.

getRootGraph.desc: Goes up to the root graph.

getDirtyChildren.desc: Collects the ids of 'dirty' macros used by child instances.

setDirty.desc: Marks the graph (and its children of the same type) as modified; by default starting from the root.

gatherNodesAndLinks.desc: Adds to rNodes and rLinks the nodes and links of this graph and its children, and fills interInfo for macro/integrated nodes.

resolveInterHops.desc: Follows links through macro/integrated and macro/io nodes to create virtual links (virtualLink) between the real source and the real targets.

plan.desc: Plans the execution (non-macro root graph): dependencies, flow roots, color propagation, node order, execution code generation. Called by the manager before starting or after a modification.

clear.desc: Deletes the child graphs, destroys the nodes and clears nodes, links, pins.

createNode.desc: Creates a node of a given type (e.g. 'events/onUpdate') from the manager's templates. Logs an error and returns nil if the type is unknown. Marks obsolete nodes in their name.

....desc: arguments passed to the node constructor

moveNodeToGraph.desc: Moves a node to another graph, deleting its links.

deleteNode.desc: Deletes a node and its links (except undeleteable nodes outside debug mode; a node that represents a graph deletes that graph, unless ignoreIntegratedNodes).

ignoreIntegratedNodes.desc: do not delete the represented graph

createLink.desc: Creates a link between an output pin and an input pin (after removing the hardcoded value from the target pin).

deleteLink.desc: Deletes a link: updates pinIn / _mInFlow of the target, notifies pins and nodes, schedules the deletion on the editor side.

_onSerialize.desc: Serializes the graph (name, nodes, ordered links, type, variables, view, parentId...). Returns the table and the smallest id used.

_onDeserialized.desc: Rebuilds the graph (nodes sorted by id, links, variables) from the serialized data.

linkExists.desc: True if a link already exists between these two pins.

hasLink.desc: True if an input pin of a type other than flow/state is already linked.

pinsCompatible.desc: Tests the type compatibility of two pins: 'any' accepts everything, 'state' pins link only to each other, table types must have the same tableType or 'generic'.

canCreateLink.desc: True if a link can be created between a and b (opposite directions, different nodes, compatible types, no existing link, equal names if matchName).

findPin.desc: Returns the pin with the given id.

updateChildrenTypes.desc: Applies a type to this graph and its descendants (stops at ignoreType).

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the project starts: notifies each node.

_onClear.desc: Notifies the nodes and the variableStorage of a clear.

_executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: notifies the nodes and the variableStorage.

getMacro.desc: For a graph of type 'instance', returns the corresponding original macro graph.

getInstanceRoot.desc: Returns the root of the instance (first ancestor with macroID).

getChildPosition.desc: Returns the sequence of indices of this graph among the children from the root of the instance.

getDeepChild.desc: Descends into the children according to indices (see notes: uses a nonexistent children field).

getRecursiveHooksAndDependencies.desc: Recursively collects the nodes (for their hooks) and the extension dependencies declared by the nodes.

findNodeRecursive.desc: Looks for a node by id in this graph then in its children.

forceRecursiveNodeUpdatePosition.desc: Forces the update of the editor position of all nodes (recursive).

_printStructure.desc: Recursively prints the tree of graphs with indentation.

printStructure.desc: Prints the tree of graphs (only from a root).

getParentWithStates.desc: Like getParent, but if the graph has no parent, returns the state graph in which a node represents this graph.

getChildrenWithStates.desc: Children of the graph, plus (for a state graph) the non-state graphs represented by its nodes.

getSiblings.desc: Returns the sibling graphs (same parent, states included); prints the parent's name (see notes).

getLocation.desc: Returns the path of the graph from the root (names, or ids if withIds), parent states included.
